description: Search peptide vendors by verification score (default order; null = insufficient data or unscored, never guessed), Finnrick rating, lab pass rate, payment, where they ship from, how to order and how to contact them (email, phone, WhatsApp, Telegram, socials). Each vendor carries a contact card.

min_pass.description: Minimum lab pass rate in percent.

min_score.description: Minimum Finnrick rating (0-100, as Finnrick publishes it).

min_verification.description: Minimum verification score (0-100, computed from checkable evidence; see get_rules). Unscored vendors never match.

peptide.description: Only vendors that list this peptide (slug).

ships_from.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 (US, CN, HK, CA, GB, AU…) or EU.

name: search_vendors
title: Search Peptide Vendors
